Because in Othello you **can’t choose any empty square** — you can only play a square if it **flips at least one disc**.

So White couldn’t just take **g2** or **h1** unless placing there would sandwich a line of Black discs between that new White disc and another White disc.

Plain version: White wasn’t “stuck strategically”; they were **stuck by the rules**. No flip = no move.
